title: apium ammi f. latisectum
intro: Apium ammi f. latisectum, commonly known as lover's herb or bulbous carrot fern, is a plant species in the carrot family. It is native to the Mediterranean region and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits. The health benefits of Apium ammi f. latisectum include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce swelling and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties.
